quantities: Two reliefs at the parallel velocity of the globally shortest uncapped cell. Each top covers the mapped Z and mu faces of one native cell. Depth increases with mu toward the aisle. Height is m_per_decade * log10(quantity / axis_min). A 28 mm lip hangs below the front cell tops. The saved rate is cflrate/1e9 in 10^9 s^-1. The unit-Courant step in ns is its reciprocal. The violet tops use the saved beta < 1 mask.
ridge: At the centre of the highest mu bin, reconstruct the uncapped rate as saved rate / beta. The amber ribbon reproduces that rate and its reciprocal cell by cell along Z at the same saved instant. It is offset 42 to 75 mm toward the aisle for visibility.
verification: Recover the input rate and reciprocal from every height; check all violet tops against the saved cap. Reload the GLB and compare every triangle with the native-face coordinates and height to 1e-7 exhibit m.
